outcome: Serious maternal hypertensive disorder (preeclampsia, eclampsia or HELLP syndrome)
cohort: The study included 41 pregnancies among 34 kidney transplant recipients followed in a single center over 30 years.
finding: Graft function parameters (proteinuria >669 mg/g, serum creatinine >1.75 mg/dL, and glomerular filtration rate <36.2 mL/min/1.73 m2) measured before pregnancy were significantly correlated with adverse maternal, fetal, and graft outcomes during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 69.4% of the patients.
